title: Cholesteric Fingers from a Magnetic Perspective: Topology, Energetics, and Interactions
summary: Chiral liquid crystals and chiral magnets host a wide variety of topological solitons described by closely related continuum theories, namely the Frank-Oseen and Dzyaloshinskii models. Exploiting this correspondence, we develop a unified description of cholesteric fingers in confined liquid crystals and their magnetic counterparts. Within a continuum framework including bulk and surface anisotropies, we analyze the topology, structure, interactions, and collective states of the two main finger types, CF-1 and CF-2.
